title: Vending Machine Controller
statement: Build a simple vending machine controller that accepts coins of 5 and 10 units and dispenses a product when at least 15 units are inserted. It must maintain accumulated credit across clock cycles and produce a pulse when the product is ready. A synchronous reset should clear the stored credit.
module_signature: module vending_machine_controller(input clk, input rst, input coin5, input coin10, output reg dispense);
behavior: Track the inserted amount and dispense when credit >= 15.
dispense pulses high for one cycle when product is released.
rst synchronously resets the stored credit to zero.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous counters or unclocked state storage.
hint: Use an FSM with a small credit accumulator and transitions for each coin type.
